factor_name: Moderately elevated volatility-transition gated 5D shock reversal

calculation.description: Cross-sectional contrarian standardized five-day return, activated when the cross-asset short-volatility to medium-volatility ratio is moderately elevated. Signal is shifted one completed day to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 10D IC was positive in 2020-24 (+0.00583), 2025-29 (+0.00257), 2030-32 (+0.02773), and 2033-34 (+0.01748). Predictive power is horizon-specific and reverses at 20D and 40D. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation.
